name: Michael E. Farbiarz
service_line_reviewed: Article III service reviewed: 2023–13 September 2026. Selected decisions: 2.

biography.text: Born in 1973 in New York City. Farbiarz earned an A.B. from Harvard College (1995) and a J.D. from Yale Law School (1999). He clerked for U.S. District Judge Michael B. Mukasey and Second Circuit Judge José A. Cabranes; practiced in New York; served as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in the Southern District of New York; and held senior legal, inspector-general, and governance posts at the Port Authority. President Biden nominated him.
education_sentences: Farbiarz earned an A.B. from Harvard College (1995) and a J.D. from Yale Law School (1999).

other_writings.text: “Accuracy and Adjudication: The Promise of Extraterritorial Due Process,” 116 Columbia Law Review 625 (2016). The article argues for accuracy-oriented due-process protections in extraterritorial adjudication. Open publication
